# Christopher Kelly, Enterprise AI SEO Consultant

> Christopher Kelly is a senior, hands-on enterprise AI SEO consultant based in Newcastle upon Tyne, UK, working with brands worldwide. He gets multi-location and multi-brand businesses understood, cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Mode and AI Overviews. The consultancy is operated by Ascend Digital Marketing Ltd (Companies House 16822903).

Key facts:
- Background: multi-year SEO and AI search delivery for a global luxury hotel group across 15+ properties on four continents (the client is named on request).
- Notable result: a resort's destination page cited by Google's AI Overview as both the definition and the getting-there source.
- Automation: n8n, API and MCP workflows, including local SEO audits that generate in about two minutes.
- Named clients include Stowe Family Law, Simpson Millar, Fulham Road Dental, Direct Dental, Bankless, RedStone Finance, Bity, Thesis, Mezo, Trojan, Crestal and Bando.
- Every engagement starts with a 15 minute call: https://tidycal.com/christopherkelly00/15-minute-meeting
